Ceema B2B Outreach OpenClaw middleware plugin","maintainers":[{"name":"alphaceema","email":"alphaceema@gmail.com"}],"readme":"# Alpha Ceema B2B Outreach: Global Company Intelligence for OpenClaw

Turn your OpenClaw AI into a world-class, unstoppable marketing team. 

The **Alpha Ceema B2B Outreach** plugin provides your AI agents with direct, unmitigated access to data on **every company in the world**. Designed for modern Account-Based Marketing (ABM) and large-scale outbound prospecting, this plugin empowers your AI to autonomously discover, enrich, and engage with global leads at an unprecedented scale.

## The Ultimate AI Marketing Engine

Stop manually scraping lists. By giving your OpenClaw agents access to our global firmographic database, your AI can now:
- 🌍 **Automate Global Prospecting:** Identify and build lists of target accounts from a comprehensive database of global companies.
- 🎯 **Hyper-Personalize Outreach:** Fetch deep-dive metadata to craft highly personalized marketing campaigns based on exact company profiles.
- ⚙️ **Execute Account-Based Marketing (ABM):** Seamlessly integrate with your CRM workflows to let the AI handle lead enrichment and top-of-funnel outbound marketing autonomously.

## Installation

Install globally via NPM or ClawHub to instantly supercharge your OpenClaw agents:

```bash
openclaw plugins install openclaw-plugin-alpha-ceema-b2b-outreach
```

## Agent Tool Arsenal

Your AI marketing agents will automatically gain access to:

- `list_companies`: The ultimate discovery engine. Allows the agent to query the global database, returning paginated, sorted lists of companies ready for outreach.
- `get_company`: The enrichment tool. Pulls comprehensive intelligence on a specific company to inform hyper-personalized marketing copy.

## Built for Scale & Security
As a marketing professional, you know data is only as good as the infrastructure holding it. Alpha Ceema is built with O(1) pagination, defensive payload limiting, and robust error handling to ensure your automated campaigns never drop a lead.
